title: Ice & Gold Black Friday
lede: The whole plan on one page. All times are Eastern.

moments.what: Free studs offer ends. Those ads come off.
Black Friday ads start. Sale budget $300 a day. 4 for $150 and everyday ads go down to $50 a day each.
Sale budget goes to $500 a day.
We check at 9am, 1pm, 5pm and 9pm and move the budget by the rules below.
Cyber Monday ads on. Black Friday ads with no sales come off. Sale budget $500 a day.
Back to normal. Black Friday ads end by themselves. 4 for $150 and everyday ads back to $100 a day.

sections.title: Black Friday
sections.sub: Thu Nov 26 to Mon Nov 30. One budget for both boxes.

goal.line: We want every $1 in ads to bring back $2.50.

ladder.title: When we raise or lower the budget
ladder.intro: We look at the whole store: every sale divided by every ad dollar. Checked 4 times a day.

rungs.action: Cut 25%, and turn off any ad that spent $114 with no sale
Back to $500, and check the site and checkout

ladder.note: We start at $300 on Thanksgiving and $500 Black Friday, then the ladder decides.
